items.detail: All four sub-parts verified live. (1) With .gitreins/verdicts/verdict.json created: `git check-ignore -v .gitreins/verdicts/verdict.json` -> `.gitignore:47:.gitreins/verdicts/  .gitreins/verdicts/verdict.json`, exit 0 — the single-path snapshot matches the rule at .gitignore:47. Test fixture cleaned up afterward; tree clean.
